facts.title: daisyUI - Tailwind CSS Component Library
facts.description: Tailwind CSS component library by daisyUI. Build faster with semantic components, built-in themes, and reusable UI blocks.

research.name: daisyUI
research.note: Tailwind CSS plugin that adds semantic component class names and a set of built-in themes.
unverified: The source is public at github.com/saadeghi/daisyui (MIT); research that repository instead.
Pricing is freemium because the daisyUI store sells templates and a Figma library; the component library itself is free.
